settings.title: Discovery
settings.subtitle: A separate, stranger-facing opt-in — different from the link-based sharing above.
settings.explainer: Sharing above gives one link full access to your whole profile. Discovery is different: it lets people who don't have any link find you in a browsable list and send you a short message. Off by default.
settings.scopeIntents: Only for what I choose below
settings.needAssessments: Complete at least 2 assessments before turning this on — Discovery needs a combined profile to show.
settings.previewEmpty: Turn this on to see your preview.
settings.error: Failed to update your Discovery settings

browse.title: Discover
browse.subtitle: People who've opted in to being approached by strangers — not the same as your pairing/team connections.
browse.empty: No one matches right now — check back later.
browse.needOwnProfile: Complete at least 2 assessments to see how you compare with people here.
browse.loadError: Couldn't load the discovery list right now.
browse.loadMoreError: Couldn't load more people right now.

compose.title: Approach {name}
compose.messagePlaceholder: Mention something specific from their profile — generic messages are easy to ignore.
compose.messageTooShort: Write a bit more — at least 20 characters.

requests.title: Approach Requests
requests.connectedNotice: You're both connected — no chat here yet, but you can each see this on your requests list.

safety.blockConfirmBody: They won't be able to see your profile or approach you again. They won't be notified.

skipped.title: Skipped People
skipped.subtitle: People you've skipped in Discover. Skipping is private and reversible — they're never notified, and undoing it here lets them show up in your feed again.
